name: Dear Sticky – Floating Action Buttons, Sticky Notifications & Navbar
author: Sanchit Pandey

sections.description:
Dear Sticky is a comprehensive WordPress plugin that transforms your website’s user engagement with powerful floating action buttons and sticky notification bars. Perfect for e-commerce stores, service businesses, bloggers, and any website looking to increase customer interaction, generate leads, and boost conversions.

🎯 Why Choose Dear Sticky?

Dear Sticky helps you convert website visitors into customers by providing instant access to communication channels, feedback collection, and important announcements. With its intuitive interface and real-time preview, you can set up professional floating buttons and notification bars in minutes.

✨ Key Features

🚀 Floating Action Buttons (FAB)

  • 11+ Button Types: WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Telegram, Instagram, X (Twitter), Email, Phone, Custom Links, Feedback Forms, Scroll to Top
  • Live Mobile Preview: See real-time changes with built-in responsive preview
  • Advanced Customization: Colors, positions, sizes, tooltips, and animations
  • Smart Positioning: Place buttons in any corner with flexible positioning
  • Performance Optimized: Lightweight code that won’t slow down your site

📢 Sticky Notification Bars

  • Custom Announcements: Display important messages, promotions, or news
  • Smart Display Options: Show always, once per user, or auto-hide after timeout
  • Cookie Management: Remember user preferences and dismissed notifications
  • Fully Responsive: Perfect display on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
  • Color Customization: Match your brand with custom background and text colors

💬 Advanced Feedback System

  • Built-in Contact Forms: Collect visitor feedback directly in WordPress
  • Database Storage: Secure storage of all submissions with admin dashboard
  • Email Notifications: Instant alerts when new feedback is received
  • Message Management: Expandable feedback messages with easy admin interface
  • GDPR Compliant: Local storage with privacy policy support

🌟 Perfect For:

  • E-commerce Stores: Instant customer support via WhatsApp and phone
  • Service Businesses: Lead generation with contact buttons and feedback forms
  • Bloggers & Content Creators: Grow social media following with social buttons
  • Corporate Websites: Display important announcements and company news
  • Non-profits: Easy contact forms and donation call-to-actions
  • Any Website: Improve user engagement and conversion rates

🔧 Supported Platforms & Integrations

  • WhatsApp Business: Direct chat with pre-filled messages
  • Social Media: Facebook, Instagram, Twitter/X, Telegram, LinkedIn
  • Communication: Email, phone calls, custom URLs
  • Forms: Built-in feedback collection and contact forms
  • Navigation: Smooth scroll to top functionality

🚀 Coming Soon Features

  • Sticky Navigation Bar: Make your menu stick on scroll
  • Advanced Animations: Custom entrance and hover effects
  • A/B Testing: Test different button configurations
  • Analytics Integration: Track button clicks and conversions
  • Multi-language Support: Full internationalization
  • Advanced Targeting: Show buttons based on user behavior

💡 Pro Tips

  • Use contrasting colors for better visibility
  • Add compelling call-to-action text in tooltips
  • Test different positions for maximum engagement
  • Combine notification bars with floating buttons for best results
  • Use feedback forms to collect valuable customer insights

🔒 Security & Performance

  • GDPR Compliant: Local data storage with privacy controls
  • Performance Optimized: Minimal CSS/JS loading
  • Secure Code: Regular security updates and best practices
  • WordPress Standards: Follows all WordPress coding standards

Privacy Policy

Dear Sticky stores feedback form submissions in your WordPress database. This data includes:
* Visitor name
* Visitor email
* Feedback message
* Submission date

This data is stored locally on your server and is not transmitted to any third-party services. You are responsible for informing your visitors about data collection in accordance with applicable privacy laws (such as GDPR).

Development

Source Code

The source code for Dear Sticky is publicly available on GitHub: https://github.com/sanchitpandeyyy/Dear-Sticky

The src/ directory contains the human-readable source code for JavaScript and CSS files. The build/ directory contains the minified/compiled versions used in production.

Build Instructions

To build the plugin from source:

  1. Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/sanchitpandeyyy/Dear-Sticky.git
  2. Navigate to the plugin directory: cd dear-sticky
  3. Install dependencies: npm install
  4. Build the assets: npm run build
  5. For development with watch mode: npm start

The plugin uses WordPress Scripts for building JavaScript and CSS assets.

Credits

Dear Sticky is developed with ❤️ by Sanchit Pandey – A passionate WordPress developer dedicated to creating tools that help website owners succeed.

Technical Stack

  • Framework: Built with WordPress Scripts
  • Icons: Powered by Font Awesome – The world’s most popular icon set
  • UI Components: Modern React-based admin interface
  • Database: Native WordPress database integration
  • Security: WordPress security best practices

Special Thanks

  • WordPress Community for the amazing platform
  • Font Awesome for beautiful icons
  • All beta testers and early adopters
  • Open source community for inspiration

Support & Documentation

  • 📖 Documentation: sanchit.pro/documentation
  • 🆘 Support: sanchit.pro/contact
  • 💝 Donate: Support development at sanchit.pro

sections.installation:
Dear Sticky is incredibly easy to install and configure. Get your floating buttons and notification bars up and running in just a few minutes!

Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Dear Sticky” in the plugin search box
  4. Click Install Now next to Dear Sticky
  5. Click Activate to start using the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the dear-sticky.zip file from WordPress.org
  2. Upload the dear-sticky folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Activate the plugin through Plugins > Installed Plugins
  4. Navigate to Dear Sticky in your admin sidebar

Quick Setup Guide

  1. Go to Dear Sticky > Dashboard in your WordPress admin
  2. Click on Floating Buttons tab
  3. Choose your button type (WhatsApp, Email, Phone, etc.)
  4. Customize colors, position, and size
  5. Add tooltip text and pre-filled messages
  6. Enable the button and save changes
  7. Visit your website to see the floating button in action!

Notification Bar Setup

  1. Go to Dear Sticky > Notifications tab
  2. Enter your announcement message
  3. Choose background and text colors
  4. Set display options (always show, timed, or once per user)
  5. Configure close button and cookie settings
  6. Save and preview on your site

Feedback Form Setup

  1. Enable feedback button in Floating Buttons settings
  2. Customize button appearance
  3. Set up email notifications in settings
  4. View submissions in the Feedback dashboard tab

That’s it! Your website now has professional floating action buttons and notification bars that will help increase user engagement and conversions.
sections.faq:
How do I add a WhatsApp floating button to my WordPress site?

Adding a WhatsApp button is simple:
1. Install and activate Dear Sticky plugin
2. Go to Dear Sticky > Floating Buttons in your admin
3. Enable the floating button toggle
4. Select “WhatsApp” as the button type
5. Enter your WhatsApp number (include country code, exclude +)
6. Add a pre-filled message (optional but recommended)
7. Choose colors, position, and size
8. Save changes and visit your site!

Can I change the floating button position?

Absolutely! Dear Sticky offers flexible positioning:
– Bottom Right (default – most effective)
– Bottom Left
– Top Right
– Top Left

Choose the position that best fits your website design and user behavior.

How do I customize the button colors and appearance?

Dear Sticky offers extensive customization:
1. Go to Floating Buttons settings
2. Choose from preset color schemes or pick custom colors
3. Select button size (Small, Medium, Large)
4. Add hover tooltips with call-to-action text
5. Use the live preview to see changes instantly

How do I create a sticky notification bar?

  1. Navigate to Dear Sticky > Notifications
  2. Enter your announcement message
  3. Choose background and text colors
  4. Set display frequency:
    • Always: Shows on every page load
    • Once per user: Uses cookies to show only once
    • Timed: Auto-hide after specified seconds
  5. Enable/disable close button
  6. Save and preview

Can visitors dismiss the notification bar?

Yes! You can make notification bars dismissible:
– Enable the close button option
– Set cookie duration to remember dismissed bars
– Choose between permanent dismissal or time-based reappearance

Does the feedback form send email notifications?

Yes! Dear Sticky includes comprehensive email notifications:
– Automatic emails when feedback is submitted
– Customizable recipient email addresses
– HTML formatted messages with all form data
– Stored in WordPress database for admin review

Where can I view feedback submissions?

All feedback submissions are stored in your WordPress database and displayed in the Dear Sticky admin dashboard:
1. Go to Dear Sticky > Feedback
2. View all submissions in a clean, organized table
3. Click to expand and read full messages
4. Sort by date, name, or email
5. Export or manage submissions easily

Is Dear Sticky mobile responsive?

100% mobile responsive! The plugin is designed for all devices:
– Responsive floating buttons that work on phones and tablets
– Mobile-optimized notification bars
– Touch-friendly button sizes
– Optimized for all screen resolutions

Will Dear Sticky slow down my website?

No! Dear Sticky is built with performance in mind:
– Lightweight, optimized code
– Minimal CSS and JavaScript loading
– Only loads assets when needed
– No impact on page speed scores
– Compatible with caching plugins

Can I use multiple floating buttons?

Currently, Dear Sticky supports one floating button per page. However:
– You can use different buttons on different pages
– Multi-button support is planned for future updates
– Notification bars can complement your floating button

Is Dear Sticky compatible with my theme?

Dear Sticky works with all WordPress themes that follow WordPress coding standards. The plugin:
– Uses standard WordPress hooks and filters
– Doesn’t modify theme files
– Works with popular page builders (Elementor, Divi, etc.)
– Compatible with most caching and optimization plugins

Can I add custom links or URLs to buttons?

Yes! Dear Sticky supports custom links:
1. Select “Custom Link” as button type
2. Enter any URL (internal or external)
3. Add UTM parameters for tracking
4. Set link to open in new tab
5. Add custom tooltips

How do I track button clicks and conversions?

While Dear Sticky doesn’t include built-in analytics, you can track performance using:
– Google Analytics UTM parameters
– Custom link tracking
– Facebook Pixel for social buttons
– Google Tag Manager integration
– Built-in WordPress analytics

Can I use Dear Sticky with page builders?

Yes! Dear Sticky integrates seamlessly with:
– Elementor – Works with all Elementor pages
– Divi Builder – Compatible with Divi themes
– Gutenberg – Full block editor support
– Classic Editor – Works with classic WordPress editor
– All major page builders

My floating button isn’t showing up. What should I do?

Common solutions:
1. Check if plugin is activated – Go to Plugins and ensure Dear Sticky is active
2. Clear cache – Clear your site and browser cache
3. Check settings – Ensure button is enabled in admin
4. Theme conflicts – Temporarily switch to default theme
5. Plugin conflicts – Deactivate other plugins temporarily

The notification bar looks wrong on mobile. How to fix?

Mobile display issues are usually caused by:
1. Theme CSS conflicts – Check for custom mobile styles
2. Viewport settings – Ensure proper responsive meta tags
3. Custom CSS – Remove any custom notification styles
4. Plugin updates – Ensure you’re using the latest version

Can I get support for Dear Sticky?

Yes! Support options include:
– Documentation: Comprehensive online guides
– Community Forums: WordPress.org support forums
– Developer Support: Direct support from the developer
– Video Tutorials: Step-by-step setup guides

Is Dear Sticky GDPR compliant?

Yes! Dear Sticky follows GDPR and privacy best practices:
– Local data storage only
– No data sent to third parties
– Cookie consent integration
– Privacy policy generator included
– Data export/deletion capabilities

What data does Dear Sticky collect?

Dear Sticky only collects data you explicitly configure:
– Feedback form submissions (name, email, message)
– Notification bar dismissal cookies
– No personal tracking or analytics data
– All data stored locally on your server
